contextual_exchange.speaker: Unseen young man’s voice before Clifford’s named entrance
contextual_exchange.source_Japanese:
＜颯爽とした青年の声＞
ん？　あんたたちか？
エスピノサを倒したというのは？
contextual_exchange.english: [A confident young man's voice] Hm? Are you the ones who defeated Espinosa?

contextual_exchange.speaker: James Clifford
contextual_exchange.source_Japanese:
ありがたいことだ
これで我々イギリスも、心おきなく
アフリカに進出できるというもの
contextual_exchange.english: Splendid. Now England can expand into Africa without concern.

contextual_exchange.speaker: James Clifford
contextual_exchange.source_Japanese:
エスピノサは、ここで相当に
おいしい商売をしていたらしいからな
いや、実に運がいい
contextual_exchange.english: Espinosa seems to have made a very handsome profit here. What splendid luck.

contextual_exchange.speaker: Maria Li
contextual_exchange.source_Japanese:
…何か誤解があるようね
私は、エスピノサの後がまを
募集した覚えはないけれど
contextual_exchange.english: ...You seem to have misunderstood. I don't recall asking for someone to take Espinosa's place.
